subtitle: A journey through code, curiosity, and the soundtrack that carried it all.

tracks.title: Press Play
tracks.lead: Hey there! I'm Bhavay… but my friends call me Bunny.
tracks.text: Before we begin, a little secret: this story has a soundtrack. Music has been with me through every chapter. Grab your headphones, or just keep scrolling.
tracks.notes: Music has been with me through every chapter. It was there in the quiet moments, the big wins, the scary leaps, and everything in between. So grab your headphones (or keep scrolling, that works too), and let's hop in.
tracks.mood: Gentle lo-fi intro, warm and inviting, like headphones going on

tracks.title: The Quiet Kid in the Corner
tracks.lead: Every story needs a beginning. Mine starts in a corner.
tracks.text: I was the quiet kid, building, painting and daydreaming, with music always playing. Then I met Python. It was love at first print("Hello, World!"), and I never looked back.
tracks.notes:
While the world buzzed around me, I was busy building things, painting things, or simply daydreaming about things that didn't exist yet. And there was always music playing. It was my company, my comfort, and the fuel for my imagination. A good song could turn a blank page into a whole new world.

I didn't know it then, but I was already doing what developers do best: imagining something new… and then figuring out how to make it real.

And then I met Python. Suddenly, all those daydreams had a way out of my head and onto a screen. Blocks became code. Paintings became programs. And the quiet kid in the corner discovered he had a superpower. Late-night coding sessions with a playlist on loop? That's where the magic happened. Code has rhythm too, after all.
tracks.mood: Soft piano that builds into an upbeat synth drop

tracks.title: The Brag Board
tracks.lead: Fair warning: I like to brag a little.
tracks.text: A world title, a research club, two publications and a few side quests, pinned one by one.
tracks.notes:
During COVID, when the world needed help, I built a prototype app to detect counterfeit medicine. It went all the way to the top and won the Microsoft Imagine Cup Junior 2021.

At my college literature society I was the Tech Lead and the Debate Champion: code and communication, side by side. As President of the University Research Club, I organized a research summit, published my work, and helped bring big ideas to life. I also co-founded Intern Hub, our college placement cell, because helping others land their dream jobs is pretty awesome too.

pins.title: World Champion
pins.text: Microsoft Imagine Cup Junior 2021, for an app that detects counterfeit medicine

pins.title: Published author
pins.text: Book chapter on AI fashion recommendation; peer-reviewed paper on geo-processing with Python

pins.title: Side quests
pins.text: A real-time sign-language translator and an AI recommendation engine

pins.title: Co-founder, Intern Hub
pins.text: The college placement cell I co-founded

tracks.mood: Triumphant, brass-heavy anthem with drum hits

tracks.title: The Plot Twist
tracks.lead: 2024. Everyone expected the developer to keep developing.
tracks.text: Instead I took a detour to Teleperformance, supporting Adobe customers. On the front lines I learned that great technology starts with understanding people.
tracks.notes:
I joined Teleperformance as a Customer Service Associate, supporting Adobe customers. A completely unexpected trajectory, and honestly? One of the best decisions I ever made.

It wasn't always easy. Some days were long, and some calls were tough. But after every shift, the headphones came back on, and music helped me reset, recharge, and remember where I was headed.

On the front lines, I learned what real people struggle with every single day. I listened, I solved problems, and I discovered that great technology starts with understanding people.
tracks.stat: New skill unlocked: empathy, ground-level edition
tracks.mood: Record scratch, silence, then slow acoustic guitar

tracks.title: Back to the Future of AI
tracks.lead: 2025. The detour led straight back to tech.
tracks.text: At Keywords Studios I became an AI researcher on Amazon Nova Act and Mecka AI, was promoted to senior, and built a Python based QA workflow that lifted data quality from 58% to 78%.
tracks.notes:
At Keywords Studios, I became an AI Researcher, working on AI data operations and quality programs: Amazon Nova Act, helping teach AI agents to get things done, and Mecka AI, building the data layer for physical AI, the kind that will one day move around in the real world.

I started as a Technical Research Associate, got promoted to Senior Research Associate, led a big team of brilliant researchers, and built an automated Python-based QA workflow that lifted our data quality from 58% to 78%. Big deadlines, big teams, big challenges, and a "focus mode" playlist that never let me down.
tracks.mood: Electronic and futuristic, building layer by layer

tracks.title: Leading the Runway
tracks.lead: Next stop: Flixstock, where tech meets fashion.
tracks.text: As an AI Project Manager I lead AI operations and development for fashion, for a major global client. Leading a team is like conducting a band: the magic happens in harmony.
tracks.notes:
As an AI Project Manager, I led teams in AI operations and development for the fashion industry, working with a major global client, juggling timelines, keeping everyone in sync, and making sure the work looked as good as the clothes.

Turns out leading a team is a lot like conducting a band: everyone plays a different part, and the magic happens when it all comes together in harmony.
tracks.stat: New skill unlocked: leading people, not just pipelines

tracks.title: To Be Continued…
tracks.lead: So where am I now? Exploring.
tracks.text: From a quiet corner to AI labs, customer headsets and fashion runways, I'm still that same curious wanderer, and the music is still playing.
tracks.notes:
I'm wandering into new domains, sharpening my skills, and getting ready for the next big adventure. Because if this journey has taught me anything, it's that the best chapters are usually the ones you didn't see coming.

The only difference? Now I've got Python too.
tracks.mood: Hopeful and open-ended, a melody that feels like a sunrise

whyMusic: When I was dreaming, it gave my imagination somewhere to go
When I was building, it kept me in the flow
When I was winning, it was my celebration
When things got tough, it helped me feel, reset, and keep going
When I was lost, it reminded me who I am

ending.title: Want to be part of the next chapter?
